```{r}
multi_omics <- multi_omics_full
filtered_exps <- lapply(names(multi_omics_full), function(multi_omics_names){
    multi_omics_exp <- experiments(multi_omics_full)[[multi_omics_names]]
    p_val_dt <- rowData(multi_omics_exp)[,grepl("adj.p.value", colnames(rowData(multi_omics_exp)))]
    p_val_dt <- p_val_dt[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt))]
    multi_omics_exp <- multi_omics_exp[apply(as.matrix(p_val_dt) <= 0.05, 1, any),]
    
    # if(nrow(multi_omics_exp) == 0){return(NA)}
    
    multi_omics_exp
})
names(filtered_exps) <- names(multi_omics)
filtered_exps[is.na(filtered_exps)] <- NULL

experiments(multi_omics) <- ExperimentList(filtered_exps)
multi_omics_selected <- multi_omics_selected[multi_omics_selected %in% names(multi_omics)]
```

```{r}
multi_omics_ordered <- names(multi_omics)[c(16, 41, 13, 40, 38, 14, 
                                            39, 37, 15, 5, 11, 19, 25, 
                                            29, 33, 30, 34, 32, 36, 31, 35)]

omic_names_dict <- c("Liver RNA Sequencing", "Liver DNA Methylation", 
                    "Liver Histone Modifications", 
                    "Liver Untargeted Metabolomics", 
                    "Liver Targeted Metabolomics", "Liver Metallomics",
                    "Serum Targeted Metabolomics",

                    "Cecum 16S Metagenomics", "Colon 16S Metagenomics", 
                    "Cecum Shotgun Metagenomics", "Colon Shotgun Metagenomics",
                    paste(rep(c("Cecum","Colon"), 3), 
                        "Shotgun Functional", 
                        c("EC", "EC", "KEGG", "KEGG", "COGS", "COGS", 
                          "Pathways", "Pathways"))
                    )

names(omic_names_dict) <- multi_omics_ordered
    
group_color_dict <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(levels(droplevels(multi_omics$group))), 
                                             name = "Set2")
names(group_color_dict) <- levels(droplevels(multi_omics$group))

```
 

```{r}
omic_names_dup <- sapply(strsplit(multi_omics_ordered, "\\."), 
                        function(x){x[[1]]})
omic_names_dup[grep("cogs", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "cogs"
omic_names_dup[grep("EC", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "EC"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_kegg", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_kegg"
omic_names_dup[grep("metaerg_pathway", multi_omics_ordered)] <- "metaerg_pathway"

names(omic_names_dup) <- multi_omics_ordered

unique_omics <- unique(omic_names_dup)

omic_colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = length(unique_omics), name = "Set3")


col_list <- lapply(seq_along(unique_omics), function(omic_id){
    omic_name <- unique_omics[omic_id]
    
    colors_found <- names(omic_names_dup)[omic_names_dup == omic_name]
    
    omic_num <- length(colors_found)
    omic_col <- omic_colors[omic_id]
    
    col_ramp <- colorRampPalette(colors = c(omic_col, "white"))(omic_num + 1)[seq_len(omic_num)]
    names(col_ramp) <- colors_found
    return(col_ramp)
})

color_vect <- unlist(col_list)
omic_color_dict <- color_vect
```


```{r}
group_var <- "group"
sample_var <- "samplename"

selected_exps <- multi_omics[,colData(multi_omics)$group != "HFE", multi_omics_selected]

plot_dt <- lapply(names(experiments(selected_exps)), function(omic_name){
    omic_cd <- data.frame("sample_name" = colnames(experiments(selected_exps)[[omic_name]]))
    omic_cd$var_name <- omic_name
    omic_cd$value <- 1
    omic_cd

plot_dt <- do.call(rbind, plot_dt)
plot_dt$sample_name <- factor(plot_dt$sample_name)

group_var_dict <- colData(multi_omics)[[group_var]]
names(group_var_dict) <- colData(multi_omics)[[sample_var]]

sample_levels <- levels(plot_dt$sample_name)
reordered_sample_levels <- sample_levels[order(group_var_dict[as.character(sample_levels)])]

plot_dt$sample_name <- factor(x = plot_dt$sample_name, 
                               levels = reordered_sample_levels)

omic_color_dict_mod <- omic_color_dict
names(omic_color_dict_mod) <- omic_names_dict[as.character(names(omic_color_dict))]

    
plot_dt$var_id <- factor(omic_names_dict[as.character(plot_dt$var_name)])

plot_dt$var_id <- factor(plot_dt$var_id, 
                        levels = levels(plot_dt$var_id)[match(rev(omic_names_dict[omic_names_dict %in%

                                            levels(plot_dt$var_id))])

plot_dt_lab <- data.frame("omic_names" = unique(plot_dt$var_name), 
                          "num_vars_raw" = sapply(unique(plot_dt$var_name),

x_colors <- group_color_dict[as.character(group_var_dict[levels(plot_dt$sample_name)])]

if(!dir.exists(fig_dir)){dir.create(fig_dir)}
```

```{r}

lapply(unique(plot_dt_lab$var_id), function(omic_id){
    svg(paste0("../../outputs/Paper_Figures/figure_1_pie_", omic_id, ".svg"))
    
    plot_dt_var <- plot_dt_lab[plot_dt_lab$var_id == omic_id,]
    pie_dt <- data.frame("var_id" = plot_dt_var$var_id, 
                        "values" = c(plot_dt_var$num_vars, 
                                    plot_dt_var$num_vars_raw - plot_dt_var$num_vars),
                        "Significant" = c("Significant", "Not significant"))
    
    p <- ggplot(pie_dt, aes(x="", y= values, fill=Significant)) +
        geom_bar(stat="identity", width=1, color="white") +
        coord_polar("y", start=0) + theme_void() +
        scale_fill_manual(values = c("Significant" = "blue4",
                                     "Not significant" = "white"))
    print(p)
    dev.off()
    return(NULL)
})
```


## Enrich information

```{r}
# omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "RNA_Sequencing", "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
# ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", "entrezID", "geneId")

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", 
                 "RNA_Sequencing", 
                 "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged", 
                      "entrezID", "geneId")
omic_dt <- multi_omics_full

library(SummarizedExperiment)

## Enrich IDs dictionary
omic_dict_list <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
    
    omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
    omic_dict <- strsplit(rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]], ";")
    
    names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
    
    omic_dict
    
}, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)

rna_seq_rd <- lapply(experiments(omic_dt)[omic_enrich], rowData)
num_factors <- 2
## Universe IDs mapped
universe_list_ids <- lapply(names(rna_seq_rd), function(omic_name){
    omic_ids <- omic_dict_list[[omic_name]][paste0(omic_name, ".", rownames(rna_seq_rd[[omic_name]]))]
    omic_ids <- omic_ids[!is.null(omic_ids)]
    omic_ids <- unlist(omic_ids)
    omic_ids[!is.na(omic_ids)]

})
names(universe_list_ids) <- names(rna_seq_rd)
```


```{r}
## ORA IDs
clu_ids_enrich <- lapply(seq_len(num_factors), function(factor_id){
    omic_names <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics", "WGB_DNA_Methylation", "RNA_Sequencing")
    clu_ids <- lapply(omic_names, function(omic_id){
        omic_exp <- experiments(omic_dt)[[omic_id]]
        features_factor <- rownames(rowData(omic_exp))[rowData(omic_exp)[[paste0("Factor_", 
                                                            factor_id, "_weights_sig")]]]
        paste0(omic_id, ".", features_factor)
    })
    names(clu_ids) <- omic_names
    
    metabo_dt <- omic_dict_list[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]][clu_ids$Untargeted_Metabolomics]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.null(metabo_dt)]
    metabo_dt <- metabo_dt[!is.na(metabo_dt)]

    wgb_dt <- omic_dict_list[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]][clu_ids$WGB_DNA_Methylation]
    wgb_dt <- wgb_dt[!is.null(wgb_dt) & !is.na(wgb_dt)]
    
    rna_dt <- omic_dict_list[["RNA_Sequencing"]][clu_ids$RNA_Sequencing]
    rna_dt <- rna_dt[!is.null(rna_dt) & !is.na(rna_dt)]
    
    return(list(
        "Untargeted_Metabolomics" = metabo_dt,
        "RNA_Sequencing" = rna_dt, 
        "WGB_DNA_Methylation" = wgb_dt))
})
names(clu_ids_enrich) <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))
```

```{r}
## GSEA FCs
col_names <- paste0("Factor_", seq_len(num_factors))

omic_enrich <- c("Untargeted_Metabolomics",
                "RNA_Sequencing",
                "WGB_DNA_Methylation")
ids_enrich_names <- c("compounds_kegg_merged",
                      "entrezID", "geneId")

fc_dict <- lapply(col_names, function(col_name){
    col_name <- paste0(col_name, "_weights")
    # 
    omic_fc_dict <- mapply(function(omic_id, enrich_var){
        omic_data <- omic_dt[[omic_id]]
        omic_dict <- rowData(omic_data)[[enrich_var]]
        
        fc_dt <- rowData(omic_data)[[col_name]]
        
        names(omic_dict) <- paste0(omic_id, ".", rownames(omic_data))
        
        omic_fc <- mapply(function(var_names, fc_vect){
            var_names_split <- strsplit(var_names, ";")[[1]]
            var_names_split <- var_names_split[!is.na(var_names_split)]
            if(!length(var_names_split)){return(NULL)}
            fc_vect_dict <- rep(fc_vect, length(var_names_split))
            names(fc_vect_dict) <- var_names_split
            fc_vect_dict
        }, var_names = omic_dict, fc_vect = fc_dt, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
        
        unlist(omic_fc)
    }, omic_id = omic_enrich, enrich_var = ids_enrich_names)
    
    omic_fc_dict
})
names(fc_dict) <- col_names
```

## Gene analysis

```{r}
exp_id <- "RNA_Sequencing"

dt_exp <- multi_omics[[exp_id]]
dt_exp_raw <- multi_omics_raw[[exp_id]]
dt_exp_raw <- dt_exp_raw[,dt_exp_raw$group != "HFE"]
```

```{r}
p_val_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp)[,grepl("adj.p.value",
                                colnames(rowData(dt_exp)))]
p_val_dt_g <- p_val_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt_g))]

fc_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp)[,grepl("FC",
                                colnames(rowData(dt_exp)))]
fc_dt_g <- fc_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(fc_dt_g))]

p_val_sum <- lapply(p_val_dt_g, function(x){
    sum(x <= 0.05)
})

fc_dir <- lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    fc_dir <- ifelse(sig_vars <= 0, "Down-regulated", "Up-regulated")
    table(fc_dir)
})
names(fc_dir) <- names(fc_dt_g)
fc_dir

fc_dir


lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    summary(abs(sig_vars))
})


comp_dt <- lapply(seq_along(fc_dt_g), function(x_id){
    sig_vars <- fc_dt_g[[x_id]][p_val_dt_g[[x_id]] <= 0.05]
    summary(sig_vars)
    data.frame("fc" = sig_vars, "comparison" = names(fc_dt_g)[[x_id]])
})
comp_dt <- do.call(rbind, comp_dt)
ggplot(comp_dt) + geom_histogram(aes(x = abs(fc), fill = comparison), bins = 60) +
    theme_minimal()

tapply(abs(comp_dt$fc), INDEX = comp_dt$comparison, summary)
```

```{r}
## Variable variance tests
library(DESeq2)
dt_exp_raw_DESeq <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = assay(dt_exp_raw),
                                      colData = colData(dt_exp_raw),
                                      design= ~ 0 + group)
dt_exp_raw_DESeq <- estimateSizeFactors(dt_exp_raw_DESeq)
normalized_counts <- counts(dt_exp_raw_DESeq, normalized = TRUE)

## Without filtering
group_sds <- lapply(levels(dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group), function(x){
    group_dt <- normalized_counts[,dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group == x]
    data.frame("sd" = rowSds(as.matrix(assay(group_dt))), "group" = x)
})
group_sds <- do.call(rbind, group_sds)

ggplot(group_sds) + geom_density(aes(x = log(sd), fill = group))

tapply(X = group_sds$sd, INDEX = group_sds$group, FUN = summary)

kruskal.test(formula = sd ~ group, data = group_sds)
DescTools::ConoverTest(x = group_sds$sd, g = group_sds$group, 
                        method = "fdr", alternative = "two.sided")

# conover.test::conover.test(x = group_sds$sd, g = group_sds$group)

## With filtering
p_val_dt_g <- rowData(dt_exp_raw)[,grepl("adj.p.value",
                                        colnames(rowData(dt_exp_raw)))]
p_val_dt_g <- p_val_dt_g[,grepl("HFD-CNT|INT-HFD|INT-CNT", colnames(p_val_dt_g))]
normalized_counts_f <- normalized_counts[apply(as.matrix(p_val_dt_g) <= 0.05, 1, any),]

group_sds_f <- lapply(levels(dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group), function(x){
    group_dt <- normalized_counts_f[,dt_exp_raw_DESeq$group == x]
    data.frame("sd" = rowSds(as.matrix(assay(group_dt))), "group" = x)
})
group_sds_f <- do.call(rbind, group_sds_f)

ggplot(group_sds_f) + geom_density(aes(x = sd, fill = group))
ggplot(group_sds_f) + geom_boxplot(aes(x = group, y = log(sd)))

kruskal.test(formula = sd ~ group, data = group_sds_f)
DescTools::ConoverTest(x = group_sds_f$sd, g = group_sds_f$group, 
                        method = "fdr", alternative = "two.sided")

summary(aov(formula = log(sd) ~ group, data = group_sds_f))
TukeyHSD(aov(formula = log(sd) ~ group, data = group_sds_f))
```

```{r}
pdf(paste0(plot_output_dir, "compositions_shotgun.pdf"))

lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]

    ## Abundance plots
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts", 
                                method = "relabundance")
    
    # Getting top taxa on a Phylum level
    top_taxa <- getTopFeatures(hierarchy, top = 10, assay.type = "relabundance")
    
    # Renaming the "Phylum" rank to keep only top taxa and the rest to "Other"
    cat_renamed <- lapply(rownames(hierarchy),
                       function(x){if (x %in% top_taxa) {x} else {"Other"}})
    rowData(hierarchy)[[hierarchy_name]] <- as.character(cat_renamed)
    
    # Visualizing the composition barplot, with samples order by "Bacteroidetes"
    plotAbundance(hierarchy, assay.type= "relabundance", rank = hierarchy_name,
                  order_rank_by="abund", 
                  order_sample_by = "group",  add_x_text = TRUE) + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90))
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
## Composition sepparated
pdf(paste0(plot_output_dir, "compositions_sep_shotgun.pdf"))

lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    ## Abundance plots
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts", 
                                method = "relabundance")
    if(nrow(hierarchy) == 0){return(NULL)}
    # Getting top taxa on a Phylum level
    top_taxa <- getTopFeatures(hierarchy, top = min(nrow(hierarchy), 10), 
                                assay.type = "relabundance")
    
    # Renaming the "Phylum" rank to keep only top taxa and the rest to "Other"
    cat_renamed <- lapply(rownames(hierarchy),
                       function(x){if (x %in% top_taxa) {x} else {"Other"}})
    rowData(hierarchy)[[hierarchy_name]] <- as.character(cat_renamed)
    
    # Visualizing the composition barplot, with samples order by "Bacteroidetes"
    plotAbundance(hierarchy, assay.type= "relabundance", rank = hierarchy_name,
                  order_rank_by="abund", 
                  order_sample_by = "group",  add_x_text = TRUE) + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90)) 
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]
    
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts",
                                method = "clr", pseudocount = 1)
    
    # Run MDS on clr assay with Aitchison distance
    p1 <- data_pca(dt_list = t(scale(t(assay(hierarchy)))), 
                    metadata = colData(hierarchy),
                    stratificationVar = "group", plot_name = hierarchy_id,
                    color_vect = group_color_dict) + theme_minimal()
    p1
})
```

```{r}
library(vegan)
lapply(names(shotgun_dt_list_raw), function(hierarchy_id){
    hierarchy <- shotgun_dt_list_raw[[hierarchy_id]]
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[,hierarchy$group != "HFE"]
    
    hierarchy_name <- strsplit(hierarchy_id, "\\.")[[1]]
    hierarchy_name <- hierarchy_name[length(hierarchy_name)]
    
    hierarchy <- hierarchy[grepl(hierarchy_name, rownames(hierarchy)),]
    
    hierarchy <- transformAssay(hierarchy, assay.type = "counts",
                                method = "clr", pseudocount = 1)
    
    tse2 <- adonis(data = colData(hierarchy), assay.type = "clr",
                    formula = t(assay(hierarchy)) ~ group,
                    method = "euclidean", na.action = na.exclude)
    
    tse2$aov.tab
})
```

```{r, fig.width=3, fig.height = 3}
p_list <- lapply(metal_order, function(metal_id){

    metal_filt$region_f <- factor(metal_filt$region, 
                                levels = c("Metallomics.cecum", "Metallomics.liver"), 
                                labels = c("Gut", "Liver"))
    metal_filt$group <- droplevels(metal_filt$group)
    
    diet_metals_filt <- diet_metals_plot_2[diet_metals_plot_2$metal == metal_id,]
    diet_metals_filt$region_f <- factor(diet_metals_filt$region, 
                                levels = c("Metallomics.cecum", "Metallomics.liver"), 
                                labels = c("Gut", "Liver"))
    diet_metals_filt$group <- factor(diet_metals_filt$group, 
                                     levels = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT"), 
                                     labels = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT"))
    
    p1 <- ggplot(metal_filt, aes(x = group, y = Intensity, fill = group))  + 
        geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.2, box.linewidth = 0.1, 
                     whisker.linewidth = 0.1, alpha = 0.6) +

                alpha = 1) +
        geom_point(data = diet_metals_filt, shape = 23, size = 2,
                aes(x = group, y = mean, fill = group), color = "black",
                alpha = 1) +
        ggh4x::facet_grid2(cols = vars(region_f)) + 
        theme_minimal() + 
        theme(
            plot.margin = unit(c(1.2,0.4,0.4,0.4), "lines"), 
            axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.title.y = element_blank(),

    p1    
})
```

```{r}
cor_mat <- lapply(dt_metals, function(exp_dt){
    diet_metals_long <- diet_metals[as.character(exp_dt$group), rownames(exp_dt)]
    # plotly::plot_ly(z = cor(t(assay(exp_dt)), diet_metals_long))
    return(diag(cor(t(assay(exp_dt)), diet_metals_long)))
})

cor_test_dt <- lapply(rownames(dt_metals$Metallomics.liver), function(metal_id){
    diet_metals_long <- diet_metals[as.character(dt_metals$Metallomics.liver$group), metal_id]

        # plotly::plot_ly(z = cor(t(assay(exp_dt)), diet_metals_long))
    return(cor.test(diet_metals_long, as.numeric(assay(dt_metals$Metallomics.liver)[metal_id,])))
})
names(cor_test_dt) <- rownames(dt_metals$Metallomics.liver)
cor_test_pvals <- lapply(names(cor_test_dt), function(metal_id){
    metal_cor_test <- cor_test_dt[[metal_id]]
    data.frame("stat_pval" = metal_cor_test$p.value, "metal" = metal_id)
})
cor_test_pvals <- do.call(rbind, cor_test_pvals)
```

## Run MOFA2

We have a multi-omic dataset with over 35 datasets, including the different levels of hierarchy for the 16S and Shotgun Metagenomics and the different annotations for the functional metagenomics results.

We visualized the principal component analysis for each individual omic to have a vision of the data and select which datasets from the hierarchical levels and the functional metagenomics. With the results we choose to keep the Species hierarchy level and for the functional metagenomics the COGS and metaerg-kegg annotations.

We also applied a p-value threshold of 0.05 in any of the contrast to filter variables and match the results from the whole genome bisulphite that, because we used the DSS method that finds DMRs from clusters of statistically significant CpGs were already biased.

Thus, the MOFA model will help us find correlated feature patterns in the statistically significant data.

```{r}
                    args = list(input = "./MOFA_Models.Rmd",
```





We can look at the resulting html file and we can the that all most of the variance for all the omics data is captured by the two first factors and the third one is biased towards the RNA-Seq. This makes sense because we have big differences in variable size between all the omics, this phenomena is difficult to avoid because we have many omics with very low values, even if we didn't apply a filter, thus, as the first two factors, surprisingly don't seem to be affected by this effect, and we have all the omics represented at least with a 20% of explained variance in these, we decided to proceed with it.

The factor boxplots show quite clearly two different patterns in the data, the first factor, represents features which change by the high fat diet (HFD) and are restored to similar levels by the intervention (INT); the second one shows features that are affected by HFD but the intervention fails to restore to control levels, keeping their levels changed.

Correlating these factors with the explained variance of each omic, we can see many omics biased towards one of both factors thus, we can propose that the liver histone hodifications, metallomics, targeted metabolomics and methylomics (WGB); serum targeted metabolomics and the cecum and colon functional metagenomics KEGG have a higher variance explained in the first factor thus, are the omics with the most significant features that are restored by the intervention and the cecum metallomics and targeted metabolomics are biased toward the second factor, thus they are changed by the HFD and kept mostly unchanged by the intervention.

These correlations with the first factor correlation reveal that epigenetic signatures, when affected by the high fat diet, are mostly restored to control levels after a life-style intervention, and the histone modifications and targeted metabolomics, which focused on epigenetically relevant metabolites.

All the remaining omics: the liver untargeted metabolomics, rna-sequencing and the colon and cecum metagenomics and functional clusters of orthologous groups of proteins, have even weights indicating that they contain features that can explain the variance in both factors.

Interestingly most of the metagenomics data, except the kegg functions show this pattern with the transcriptomics and untargeted metabolomics.

Looking at the weights of each feature in these factors we can see which of them are most important in explaining these patterns of the data. We looked at the absolute value distribution of weights for each omic and used as threshold for variable selection a percentage of features proportional to the variance explained of each omic in each factor.

We applied an overrepresentation analysis (ORA) to the significant genes and differentially methylated regions from each weight, dividing them into three subset: all the weights and dividing it into positive and negative weights.

```{r}
ph1 <- pheatmap::pheatmap(mofa_seq_factors, 
                        show_rownames = FALSE, clustering_method = "average")


opposite_weights <- (mofa_seq_factors[,1] > 0 &
                        mofa_seq_factors[,2] < 0) | 
                        (mofa_seq_factors[,1] < 0 &
                            mofa_seq_factors[,2] > 0)

concording_weights <- !opposite_weights

f1_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[opposite_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] >= 0.6]
f2_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[opposite_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] <= 0.4]

f12_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[opposite_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] < 0.6 &
                                                mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] > 0.4]


f1_mofa_vars_extra <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[concording_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] >= 0.6]
f2_mofa_vars_extra <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[concording_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] <= 0.3]
f3_mofa_vars <- rownames(mofa_seq_factors)[concording_weights & mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] < 0.6 & 
                                                mofa_seq_factors_b[,1] > 0.3]
# Divisors
# f1 > 0 / f2 < 0

# 0-0.4 Kept completely altered

# 0.4-0.5 Resistant to restoration

# 0.5-1 Completely Restored 
#####
# f1 > 0 / f2 > 0
# 0-0.3 Altered and worsened with intervention
## 0.3-0.6 Altered by the intervention only
## 0.6-0.7 Small HFD alterations high intervention changes
# 0.7-1 Changes in HFD and high intervention changes

# A partir de 0.6-0.7 ja podem assignar cada variable a un factor (0.3 millor)
# f1 > 0 / f2 < 0 -> Alteració i mantenirse 
# f1 > 0 / f2 > 0 -> Alteració petita i recuperar-se més dels CTR 

# Entre 0-0.4 del F2
```

```{r}
output_dir <- paste0(params$output_dir, "MOFA_Results/", mofa_dir_name, "/")
omic_dt <- readRDS(paste0(output_dir, "multi_omics_filtered.rds"))

factor_table <- lapply(col_names, function(factor_id){
    exp_table <- lapply(names(experiments(omic_dt)), function(exp_name){
        exp_dt <- experiments(omic_dt)[[exp_name]]
        factor_vars <- mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]
        factor_vars <- names(factor_vars)[names(factor_vars) %in% rownames(exp_dt)]
        table_dt <- data.frame("Freq" = length(factor_vars),
                            "Var1" = exp_name)
        
        table_dt$factor_id <- factor_id
        table_dt$omic_color <- omic_color_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)]
         
        table_dt$Var1 <- factor(omic_names_dict[as.character(table_dt$Var1)],
                                levels = omic_names_dict)
        table_dt
    })
    exp_table <- do.call(rbind, exp_table)
    exp_table$relFreq <- exp_table$Freq/sum(exp_table$Freq)
    exp_table
})
factor_table <- do.call(rbind, factor_table)
```

## Factor 1 epigenetic relationships

### DNA Methylation

```{r}
rna_seq_dt <- omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]
rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(rna_seq_dt))]
table(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor)

dna_met_dt <- omic_dt[["WGB_DNA_Methylation"]]
rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(dna_met_dt))]
table(rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor)

info_1MB_overlap <- lapply(unique(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor), function(factor_id){
    rna_seq_factor <- rna_seq_dt[rowData(rna_seq_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id &
                                    !is.na(rowData(rna_seq_dt)$start_position),]
    dna_met_factor <- dna_met_dt[rowData(dna_met_dt)$Full_Factor == factor_id,]
    
    rna_seq_rr <- GenomicRanges::GRanges(
        seqnames = rowData(rna_seq_factor)$chromosome_id,
        ranges = IRanges(start = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_factor)$start_position) - 1e6,
        end = as.numeric(rowData(rna_seq_factor)$start_position) + 1e6,
        names = rownames(rna_seq_factor)))

    dna_met_dt_1mb <- lapply(rownames(rna_seq_factor), function(gene_id){
        ov_dt <- findOverlaps(query = rowRanges(dna_met_factor), subject = rna_seq_rr[gene_id,])
        found_dmrs <- rownames(dna_met_factor[ov_dt@from,])
        if(!length(found_dmrs)){return(NULL)}
        data.frame("DMR_ID" = found_dmrs, "Gene_ID" = gene_id)
    })

    dna_met_dt_1mb <- do.call(rbind, dna_met_dt_1mb)
    dna_met_dt_1mb$Factor_ID <- factor_id
    dna_met_dt_1mb
})

simplified_DMR_annotation <- sapply(rowData(dna_met_dt)$annotation, function(dmr_an){
            if(grepl("Promoter", dmr_an)){return("Promoter")
            } else if(grepl("Intron", dmr_an)){return("Intron")
            } else if(grepl("Exon", dmr_an)){return("Exon")
            } else if(grepl("Downstream", dmr_an)){return("Downstream")
            } else if(grepl("Distal Intergenic", dmr_an)){return("Distal Intergenic")
            } else if(grepl("Upstream", dmr_an)){return("Upstream")
            } else if(grepl("3' UTR", dmr_an)){return("3' UTR")
            } else if(grepl("5' UTR", dmr_an)){return("5' UTR")
            } else{"Other"}
        })
names(simplified_DMR_annotation) <- rownames(dna_met_dt)
```

```{r}
expr_list <- lapply(unique(mofa_factor_variable), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- paste0("Full_Factor == ", "'", factor_id, "'")
    
    if(factor_id == "Factor_12" | factor_id == "Factor_3"){factor_id <- "Factor_1"}
    
    
    list("All Weights" = as.expression(factor_expr),
         "Positive Weights" = as.expression(paste0(factor_expr, " & ", 
                                                   factor_id, "_weights > 0")),
         "Negative Weights" = as.expression(paste0(factor_expr, " & ", 
                                                   factor_id, "_weights < 0")))
})
expr_list
names(expr_list) <- unique(mofa_factor_variable)
```

```{r}
enrich_exp_list <- lapply(expr_list, function(factor_expr){
    range_dt <- rowData(rna_seq_dt)
    lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        range_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                      envir = as.data.frame(range_dt)),]
    })
})
```

##### GO enrich

```{r}
mofa_factor_go_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        enrich_res <- enrichGO(gene = rownames(weight_dt), OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, 
                                keyType = "ENSEMBL", 
                                ont = "ALL", pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        enrich_res <- clusterProfiler::simplify(enrich_res)
        
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res    
    })
})
```

##### KEGG enrich

```{r}
mofa_factor_kegg_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        entrez_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(weight_dt), 
                             column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = entrez_ids,
                                TERM2GENE = kegg_db_list$term2gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$type == "gene_id",], 
                                TERM2NAME =  kegg_db_list$term2name,
                                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = 500)
        if(is.null(enrich_res) | nrow(enrich_res@result) == 0){return(NULL)}
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```


##### Chebi enrich 

```{r}
mofa_factor_chebi_enrich <- lapply(enrich_exp_list, function(factor_dt){
    lapply(factor_dt, function(weight_dt){
        symbol_ids <- mapIds(x = org.Mm.eg.db, keys = rownames(weight_dt), 
                             column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENSEMBL")
        
        enrich_res <- enricher(gene = symbol_ids, pvalueCutoff = 0.05, 
                pAdjustMethod = "fdr", TERM2GENE = term2gene_filt, TERM2NAME = term2name_filt,
                universe = NULL, maxGSSize = Inf)
        enrich_res@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_res))
        enrich_res
    })
})
```

#### KEGG Metabolite

```{r}
expr_list <- lapply(unique(mofa_factor_variable), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- paste0("Full_Factor == ", "'", factor_id, "'")
    
    if(factor_id == "Factor_12" | factor_id == "Factor_3"){factor_id <- "Factor_1"}
    
    
    list("All Weights" = as.expression(factor_expr),
         "Positive Weights" = as.expression(paste0(factor_expr, " & ", 
                                                   factor_id, "_weights > 0")),
         "Negative Weights" = as.expression(paste0(factor_expr, " & ", 
                                                   factor_id, "_weights < 0")))
})
expr_list
names(expr_list) <- unique(mofa_factor_variable)
```


```{r}
unt_met_dt <- omic_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]
rowData(unt_met_dt)$Full_Factor <- mofa_factor_variable[as.character(rownames(unt_met_dt))]
table(rowData(unt_met_dt)$Full_Factor)
```


```{r}
library(clusterProfiler)
kegg_db_enrich_path <- paste0(params$output_dir, "kegg_enrich_db_red.rds")
kegg_db_list <- readRDS(kegg_db_enrich_path)
term2name_dt <- kegg_db_list$term2name
integ_enrich_db <- kegg_db_list$term2gene

enrich_name <- "metabolite_enrich_full"
enrich_nw_dir <- paste0(output_dir, enrich_name, "/")

if(!dir.exists(enrich_nw_dir)){dir.create(enrich_nw_dir)}
```

```{r}
full_dt <- rowData(unt_met_dt)
universe_ids <- full_dt[["compounds_kegg_merged"]]
universe_ids <- unlist(strsplit(universe_ids, ";|/"))
universe_ids <- universe_ids[!is.na(universe_ids) & universe_ids != "NA"]

set.seed(123)
met_enrich_results <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]]

    factor_res <- lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        sig_ids <- full_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(full_dt)),]$compounds_kegg_merged
        sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";|/"))
        sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(sig_ids) & sig_ids != "NA"]
        
        enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids, universe = NULL, 
                            pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                            TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "metabolite_id",],
                            TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2FC <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
        enrich_m
    })
    names(factor_res) <- names(factor_expr)
    factor_res
})

names(met_enrich_results) <- names(expr_list)

results_wb <- openxlsx::createWorkbook()
for(factor_id in names(met_enrich_results)){
    factor_dt <- met_enrich_results[[factor_id]]
    for(weight_id in names(factor_dt)){
        weight_dt <- factor_dt[[weight_id]]
    
        sheet_name <- paste(factor_id, weight_id, sep = ".")
        openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb = results_wb,
                                sheetName = sheet_name)
        openxlsx::writeData(wb = results_wb, sheet = sheet_name,
                            x = as.data.frame(weight_dt))
    }
}
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(results_wb, 
                        file = paste0(enrich_nw_dir, "met_enrich_results.xlsx"), 
                        overwrite = TRUE)
```


```{r}
full_dt <- rowData(unt_met_dt)
universe_ids <- full_dt[["compounds_kegg_merged"]]
universe_ids <- unlist(strsplit(universe_ids, ";"))
universe_ids <- universe_ids[!is.na(universe_ids)]

set.seed(123)
met_enrich_results_microb <- lapply(names(expr_list), function(factor_id){
    factor_expr <- expr_list[[factor_id]]

    factor_res <- lapply(factor_expr, function(expr_c){
        found_dt <- full_dt[eval(expr = parse(text = expr_c), 
                                envir = as.data.frame(full_dt)),]
        found_dt <- found_dt[rownames(found_dt) %in% 
                                rownames(gfcv_vars$`GFM-CVM`$Untargeted_Metabolomics),]
        
        sig_ids <- found_dt$compounds_kegg_merged
        sig_ids <- unlist(strsplit(sig_ids, ";|/"))
        sig_ids <- sig_ids[!is.na(sig_ids) & sig_ids != "NA"]
        
        enrich_m <- enricher(gene = sig_ids, universe = NULL, 
                            pvalueCutoff = 0.05, pAdjustMethod = "fdr", 
                            TERM2GENE = integ_enrich_db[integ_enrich_db$type == "metabolite_id",],
                            TERM2NAME = term2name_dt)
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2FC <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))
        enrich_m
    })
    names(factor_res) <- names(factor_expr)
    factor_res
})
```

```{r}
                                        dt_type = "ora")
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))

    })
    factor_res
})
```

```{r}
                          feature_dict_met[names(feature_dict_met) %in% rownames(unt_met_found)])

        enrich_m <- setReadable_custom(enrich_res = enrich_m, 
                                        featureDict = feature_dict, 
                                        dt_type = "ora")
        enrich_m@result$enrich_log2fc <- log2(calculate_enrich_fc(enrich_m))

    })
```

```{r}
library(stringr)
factor_ids <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_12", "Factor_2", "Factor_3")

lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    factor_vars <- names(mofa_factor_variable)[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]
    factor_metab <- unt_met_dt
    factor_metab <- factor_metab[rownames(factor_metab) %in% factor_vars,]
    pdf(paste0(mofa_figure_path, "all_metabolites_", factor_id, ".pdf"))
    lapply(rownames(factor_metab), function(f_id){
        var_exp <- factor_metab[f_id,]
        var_dt <- as.numeric(assay(var_exp))
        
        merged_cpname <- rowData(var_exp)$compounds_merged_readable
        # sapply(strsplit(merged_cpname, ";"))
        
        if(is.na(rowData(var_exp)$compounds_merged_readable)){
            compound_merged_names <- str_trunc(rowData(var_exp)$PutativeMetabolites, 
                                                75)
            compound_merged_names <- paste0(compound_merged_names, 
                                            " (No KEGG annotation)")
        } else{
            compound_merged_names <- rowData(var_exp)$compounds_merged_readable
        }
        plot_title <- paste0(compound_merged_names, "\n",
                            rowData(var_exp)$str_row_ion, "\n",
                            rowData(var_exp)$formula, " ", rowData(var_exp)$adduct_annotation,"\n",
                            "( ", f_id, " )")
        
        
        plot_dt <- data.frame("var_data" = var_dt,
                              "group" = factor_metab$group)
        p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt) +
            geom_boxplot(aes(x = group, y = var_data, fill = group)) +
            scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict) +
            ggtitle(plot_title) +
            theme_minimal()
        print(p1)
        return(NULL)
    })
    dev.off()
})
```

```{r}
# test_1 <- as.data.frame(met_gene_microb_enrich_results$Factor_2$`All Weights`)

# best untargeted metabolites
factor_rd_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){

    factor_vars <- names(mofa_factor_variable)[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]
    factor_metab <- omic_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]
    factor_metab <- factor_metab[rownames(factor_metab) %in% factor_vars,]
    
    as.data.frame(rowData(factor_metab))[,c(1:6, 20, 22, 23, 36, 
                                            37, 38, 39, 40, 41, 
                                            42, 43, 68, 69, 70, 
                                            92, 94)]

})
names(factor_rd_list) <- factor_ids

kegg_db_list$term2name$name_filt <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "",
                                        kegg_db_list$term2name$name)

all_kegg_ids <- rowData(omic_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]])[, c("compounds", "kegg_id")]
all_kegg_ids <- unlist(all_kegg_ids)
all_kegg_ids <- unlist(strsplit(all_kegg_ids, ";|/"))
all_kegg_ids <- all_kegg_ids[all_kegg_ids != "NA" & !is.na(all_kegg_ids)]
all_kegg_ids <- unique(all_kegg_ids)

all_kegg_compounds <- MetaboAnalystR::doKEGG2NameMapping(all_kegg_ids)
names(all_kegg_compounds) <- all_kegg_ids

all_kegg_compounds <- all_kegg_compounds[!grepl("^CE", names(all_kegg_compounds)) & 
                                            grepl("^C", names(all_kegg_compounds), ignore.case = FALSE)]

missing_ids <- names(all_kegg_compounds[is.na(all_kegg_compounds)])


found_info_list <- lapply(missing_ids, function(x){
    tryCatch(found_info <- KEGGREST::keggGet(x), error = function(e){
        return(NA)
    })
    return(found_info)
})
found_info_list_proc <- lapply(found_info_list, function(x){
    while(length(x) == 1){
        x <- x[[1]]
    }
    return(x)
})

found_info_list_dict <- sapply(found_info_list_proc, function(x){
    gsub(";", "", x[["NAME"]][1])
})
names(found_info_list_dict) <- sapply(found_info_list_proc, function(x){
    x[["ENTRY"]]
})
found_info_list_dict <- found_info_list_dict[!duplicated(found_info_list_dict)]

all_kegg_compounds[names(found_info_list_dict)] <- found_info_list_dict

factor_rd_list <- lapply(factor_rd_list, function(factor_rd){
    
    # factor_rd <- factor_rd_list[["Factor_2"]]
    
    
    ## Mummichog information
    num_adducts_mummichog <- sapply(factor_rd$str_row_ion, function(x){
        num_add <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
        num_add <- strsplit(num_add, ";")
        
        sapply(num_add, function(x){
            if(all(is.na(x))){return(0)} else{
                paste0(length(x), collapse = ";")
            }
        })
    })
    num_adducts_mummichog <- sapply(num_adducts_mummichog, paste, collapse = "/")
    num_adducts_mummichog[num_adducts_mummichog == ""] <- NA
    max_adducts_mummichog <- sapply(num_adducts_mummichog, function(x){
        max(as.numeric(strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]))
    })
    
    mummichog_order <- lapply(strsplit(num_adducts_mummichog, "/"), function(x){
        order(as.numeric(x), decreasing = TRUE)    
    })
    num_adducts_mummichog <- sapply(strsplit(num_adducts_mummichog, "/"), function(x){
        x[order(as.numeric(x), decreasing = TRUE)]
    })
    
    compound_keggs <- strsplit(factor_rd$compounds, "/")
    
    all(lengths(compound_keggs) == lengths(mummichog_order))
    
    compound_keggs <- sapply(seq_along(compound_keggs), function(x){
        paste0(compound_keggs[[x]][mummichog_order[[x]]], collapse = "/")
    })
    
    ###
    
    ## Hermes information
    max_isotopes_hermes <- sapply(factor_rd$iso_num, function(x){
        max(as.numeric(strsplit(x, ";|/")[[1]]))
    })
    max_isotopes_hermes[is.na(max_isotopes_hermes)] <- 0
    
    m0s_dt <- factor_rd[factor_rd$isotope == "M0",]
    
    all_formulas <- strsplit(m0s_dt$neutral_formula, "/")
    
    matched_f <- sapply(unique(unlist(all_formulas)), function(neu_f){
        
        which(sapply(factor_rd$neutral_formula, function(neu_f_feat){
            
            any(sapply(strsplit(neu_f_feat, "/")[[1]], function(f_find){
                neu_f %in% f_find
            }))
        }))
    })
        
    same_neutral_info <- lapply(factor_rd$neutral_formula, function(n_formula){
        formula_feature <- strsplit(n_formula, "/")[[1]]
        found_info <- lapply(formula_feature, function(f){
            found_formula_ids <- matched_f[[f]]
            
            found_features <- factor_rd[found_formula_ids,]
            found_adducts <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(found_features)), function(f_ids){

                found_formula_f <- strsplit(found_features$neutral_formula[f_ids],
                                            "/")[[1]] == f
                strsplit(found_features$adduct_annotation[f_ids],
                        "/")[[1]][found_formula_f]
            })
            
            data.frame("Hermes_Same_Formula_IDs" = paste(rownames(found_features),
                                                collapse = ";"),
                       "Hermes_Same_Formula_Num" = nrow(found_features),
                       "Hermes_Same_Formula_Adducts" = paste(found_adducts, 
                                                    collapse = ";"),
                       "Hermes_Same_Formula_RT" = paste(round(found_features$rtmed, 2),
                                                collapse = ";"))
                
        })
        found_info <- do.call(rbind, found_info)
        found_info <- as.data.frame(lapply(found_info, paste, collapse = "/"))
        found_info
    })
    same_neutral_info <- do.call(rbind, same_neutral_info)
    
    factor_rd <- cbind(factor_rd, same_neutral_info)
    
    multiple_annotations_hermes <- sapply(factor_rd$Hermes_Same_Formula_Num, 
                                        function(x){
        neutral_formulas <- strsplit(x, "/")[[1]]
        max(as.numeric(neutral_formulas))
    }) 
    
    ###
    
    iso_num_split <- strsplit(factor_rd$iso_num, "/")
    iso_fidelity_split <- strsplit(factor_rd$iso_fidelity,"/")
    all(lengths(iso_num_split) == lengths(iso_fidelity_split))
    
    hermes_keggs <- strsplit(factor_rd$kegg_id, "/")
    
    hermes_order <- lapply(seq_along(hermes_keggs), function(x){
        if(as.numeric(x))
        order(as.numeric(iso_num_split[[x]]),
              as.numeric(iso_fidelity_split[[x]]), decreasing = TRUE)
    })
    hermes_keggs <- lapply(seq_along(hermes_keggs), function(x){
        hermes_keggs[[x]][hermes_order[[x]]]
    })
    
    hermes_f <- strsplit(factor_rd$formula, "/")
    hermes_f <- lapply(seq_along(hermes_keggs), function(x){
        hermes_f[[x]][hermes_order[[x]]]
    })
    
    keep_ids <- lapply(hermes_keggs, function(x){
        split_dt <- strsplit(x, ";")
        keep_dt <- sapply(split_dt, function(x){
            any(x != "NA" & !is.na(x))
        })
        which(keep_dt)
    })
    
    hermes_keggs <- sapply(seq_along(hermes_keggs), function(id){
        found_keggs <- hermes_keggs[[id]]
        found_keggs <- found_keggs[keep_ids[[id]]]
        found_keggs <- sapply(strsplit(found_keggs, ";"), function(x){
            paste(unique(x[x != "NA" & !is.na(x)]), collapse = ";")
        })
        paste(gsub(" ", "", found_keggs), collapse = "/")
    })
    hermes_keggs[hermes_keggs == ""] <- NA
    
    hermes_f <- sapply(seq_along(hermes_f), function(id){
        found_f <- hermes_f[[id]]
        found_f <- found_f[keep_ids[[id]]]
        found_f <- sapply(strsplit(found_f, ";"), function(x){
            paste(x[x != "NA" & !is.na(x)], collapse = ";")
        })
        paste(found_f, collapse = "/")
    })
    
    reordered_merged_kegg <- sapply(seq_along(hermes_keggs), function(x){
        hermes_ids <- strsplit(hermes_keggs[[x]], ";|/")[[1]]
        mummi_ids <- strsplit(compound_keggs[[x]], ";|/")[[1]]
        
        kegg_ids <- c(intersect(hermes_ids, mummi_ids),
                    setdiff(mummi_ids, hermes_ids),
                    setdiff(hermes_ids, mummi_ids))
        paste(unique(kegg_ids[!is.na(kegg_ids)]), collapse = "/")
    })
    
    merged_kegg_c <- sapply(strsplit(reordered_merged_kegg, "/"), function(x){
        kegg_cp <- all_kegg_compounds[x]
        kegg_cp <- kegg_cp[!is.na(kegg_cp)]
        # kegg_cp[is.na(kegg_cp)] <- names(kegg_cp)[is.na(kegg_cp)]
        if(length(kegg_cp) == 0){
            return(paste0(x, collapse = " / "))
            print("Something bad happened :(")}
        kegg_cp <- gsub("^ | $", "", kegg_cp)
        paste0(kegg_cp, collapse = " / ")
    })
    
    
    hermes_keggs_split <- strsplit(hermes_keggs, ";|/")
    
    common_kegg <- mapply(function(compound_keg, hermes_keg){
        intersect(compound_keg, hermes_keg)
    }, compound_keg = compound_keggs, hermes_keg = hermes_keggs_split)
    
    has_common_annotation <- lengths(common_kegg) != 0

    merged_kegg_pathway <- sapply(strsplit(reordered_merged_kegg, "/"), function(kegg_ids){

        kegg_pw <- names(kegg_db_list_dt)[sapply(kegg_db_list_dt, function(x){any(x %in% kegg_ids)})]
        kegg_names <- kegg_db_list$term2name$name_filt[kegg_db_list$term2name$term %in% kegg_pw]
        paste0(kegg_names, collapse = "/")
    })

    factor_rd$merged_kegg_ids_full <- reordered_merged_kegg
    factor_rd$merged_kegg_names_full <- merged_kegg_c
    factor_rd$merged_kegg_pathways_full <- merged_kegg_pathway
    
    factor_rd[order(has_common_annotation, max_adducts_mummichog, 
                    max_isotopes_hermes, multiple_annotations_hermes, 
                    abs(factor_rd$Factor_2_weights), decreasing = TRUE),]
})
```

```{r}
targ_met_dt_full <- multi_omics_full[,,grep("Targeted", names(multi_omics_full), value = TRUE)]

targ_cor_res_dt_full <- lapply(experiments(targ_met_dt_full), function(exp_dt){
    exp_dt <- t(assay(exp_dt))
    intersect_samp <- intersect(rownames(exp_dt), rownames(mofa_factors_dt))
    cor(mofa_factors_dt[intersect_samp,], exp_dt[intersect_samp,])
})

targ_cor_res_dt_75_full <- lapply(targ_cor_res_dt_full, function(cor_dt){
    cor_factor <- apply(cor_dt, 2, function(x){
        cor_sel <- which(abs(x)/sum(abs(x)) > 0.75)
        
        # if(!length(cor_sel)){
        #     cor_sel <- intersect(which(abs(x) > 0.5), which.max(abs(x)))
        #     if(!length(cor_sel)){return(0)}
        # }
        return(cor_sel)
    })
    factor_res <- lapply(c(1, 2), function(f_id){
        names(cor_factor[cor_factor == f_id])
    })
    names(factor_res) <- c("Factor 1", "Factor 2")
    factor_res
})

targ_cor_res_dt_full <- lapply(experiments(targ_met_dt_full), function(exp_dt){
    exp_dt <- t(assay(exp_dt))
    intersect_samp <- intersect(rownames(exp_dt), rownames(mofa_factors_dt))
    factor_dt_ord <- mofa_factors_dt[intersect_samp,]
    exp_dt <- exp_dt[intersect_samp,]

    factor_res <- lapply(colnames(factor_dt_ord), function(factor_id){
        exp_res <- lapply(colnames(exp_dt), function(var_id){
            test_res <- as.data.frame(cor.test(factor_dt_ord[,factor_id],
                                               exp_dt[,var_id])[1:4])
            test_res$factor <- factor_id
            test_res$variable_id <- var_id
            test_res
        })
        do.call(rbind, exp_res)
    })
    names(factor_res) <- colnames(factor_dt_ord)
    factor_res <- do.call(rbind, factor_res)
    factor_res$adj.p.value <- p.adjust(factor_res$p.value, "fdr")
    factor_res
})

targ_cor_res_dt_full_filt <- lapply(targ_cor_res_dt_full, function(organ_dt){
    organ_dt[abs(round(organ_dt$estimate, 2)) >= 0.75 & organ_dt$adj.p.value <= 0.05,]
})
```

```{r}
lapply(names(experiments(shotgun_list)), function(omic_id){
    omic_exp <- experiments(shotgun_list)[[omic_id]]
    lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
        
        factor_exp <- omic_exp[rownames(omic_exp) %in% 
                                names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id])]
        rownames(factor_exp) <- gsub("Genus:", "", rownames(factor_exp))
        
        if(!length(factor_dt)){return(NULL)}
        if(nrow(factor_exp) < 2){return(NULL)}
        pdf(paste0(mofa_figure_path, "/", omic_id, ".", factor_id, "heatmap.pdf"))
        heatMapFun(dt_list =  as.matrix(assay(factor_exp)), metadata = as.data.frame(colData(factor_exp)), 
           stratificationVar = "group", 
           clustering_method = "complete", plot_name = "Metagenomics Genus",
           clustering_distance_rows = "euclidean",  fontsize_col = 16,
           show_colnames = TRUE)
        dev.off()
    })
})
```

```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(mia)
hierarchy_dt <- shotgun_list[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]]

hierarchy_id_all <- unique(sapply(strsplit(rownames(hierarchy_dt), ":"),
                                function(x){x[2]}))
# hierarchy_id <- strsplit(dt_id, "\\.")[[1]]
# hierarchy_id <- hierarchy_id[length(hierarchy_id)]

    
hierarchy_dt <- addTaxonomyTree(hierarchy_dt)

tree_dt <- rowTree(hierarchy_dt)
factor_list_ids <- lapply(c("Factor_1", "Factor_2", "Factor_12"), function(factor_id){
    rownames(hierarchy_dt)[rownames(hierarchy_dt) %in% 
                               names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id])]
})
names(factor_list_ids) <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2", "Factor_12")

tip_colors <- sapply(tree_dt$tip.label, function(x){
    if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_1"]]){
        if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
            return("purple1") # both factors
        } 
        return("royalblue1")
    } else if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
        return("orange1")
    } else if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_12"]]){
        return("darkgreen")        
    } else{
        return("black")
    }
})

node_colors <- sapply(tree_dt$node.label, function(x){
    if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_1"]]){
        if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
            return("purple1") # both factors
        } 
        return("royalblue1")
    } else if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_2"]]){
        return("orange1")
    } else if(x %in% factor_list_ids[["Factor_12"]]){
        return("darkgreen")        
    } else{
        return("black")
    }
})
library(ape)
pdf(paste0("../../outputs/Multi_Omics_Analysis/MOFA_Results/sig_int_thr07_paper_full/mofa_figures/", 
            "Shotgun_Metagenomics.Genus", "_dendogram.pdf"), width = 10, height = 10)
print(plot.phylo(tree_dt, show.node.label = FALSE, tip.color = tip_colors, cex = 1.5))
dev.off()
```

```{r}
    p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt) + 
        geom_boxplot(aes(x = group, y = var_data, fill = group)) + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict) + ggtitle(var_id) + 
        theme_minimal()
    print(p1)
})
dev.off()
```

```{r}
lapply(names(experiments(shotgun_ft_list)), function(omic_id){
    omic_exp <- experiments(shotgun_ft_list)[[omic_id]]
    lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
        
        var_vect <- rownames(omic_exp)[rownames(omic_exp) %in% 
                                           names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id])]
        if(!length(factor_dt)){return(NULL)}
        
        pdf(paste0(mofa_figure_path, "/", omic_id, ".", factor_id, ".pdf"))
        lapply(var_vect, function(var_id){
            var_dt <- as.numeric(assay(omic_exp[var_id,]))
                
            dt_rd <- rowData(omic_exp[var_id,])
            plot_dt <- data.frame("var_data" = var_dt, 
                                "group" = omic_exp$group)
            p1 <- ggplot(plot_dt) + 
                geom_boxplot(aes(x = group, y = var_data, fill = group)) + 
                scale_fill_manual(values = group_color_dict) + 
                ggtitle(paste(var_id, "/", dt_rd$Description, "/",
                            dt_rd$Associated_Functional_Pathway)) + 
                theme_minimal()
            print(p1)
        })
        dev.off()
```

```{r}
           show_colnames = FALSE)
```

```{r}
    dict_vect
})
omic_var_dict <- Reduce(c, omic_var_dict)

variables_dicts <- lapply(names(omic_dt), function(omic_name){
    if(omic_name == "RNA_Sequencing"){
        return("gene_lab")
    } else if(omic_name == "Untargeted_Metabolomics"){
        return("compounds_merged_readable")
        #return("HFD-CNT.formula")
    } else if(grepl("DNA_Methylation", omic_name)){
        return("geneName")
    } else if(grepl("16S|Targeted|Shotgun.*Functional", omic_name)){
        return("readable_name")  
    } else{
        return(NA)
    }
})
names(variables_dicts) <- names(omic_dt)


## KEGG pathway colors

color <- grDevices::colors()[grep('gr(a|e)y|red|tomato|orange|blue|cyan|aquamarine|azure', grDevices::colors(), invert = T)]
color
set.seed(1234)
kegg_colors <- sample(x = color, size = length(kegg_db_list$term2name$name), replace = FALSE)
names(kegg_colors) <- kegg_db_list$term2name$name

names(kegg_colors) <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", names(kegg_colors))

# KEGG term cluster

kegg_db_list_dt <- lapply(unique(kegg_db_list$term2gene$term), function(x){
    kegg_db_list$term2gene$gene[kegg_db_list$term2gene$term == x]
})

names(kegg_db_list_dt) <- unique(kegg_db_list$term2gene$term)

pathway_dist_filt <- matrix(nrow = length(kegg_db_list_dt), 
                            ncol = length(kegg_db_list_dt))

for(x in seq_along(kegg_db_list_dt)){
    for(y in seq_along(kegg_db_list_dt)){
        pathway_dist_filt[x, y] <- length(intersect(kegg_db_list_dt[[x]],
                                                kegg_db_list_dt[[y]]))/length(union(kegg_db_list_dt[[x]], kegg_db_list_dt[[y]]))    
    }
}

kegg_clu <- hclust(d = as.dist(1 - pathway_dist_filt))

kegg_colors <- kegg_colors[kegg_clu$order]

## Readable Var names dict

readable_var_names <- sapply(names(omic_var_dict), function(var_name){
    var_omic <- omic_var_dict[var_name]
    var_col <- variables_dicts[[var_omic]]
    
    var_dt <- rowData(omic_dt[[var_omic]])[var_name,]
    if(is.na(var_col)){
        return(rownames(var_dt))
    } else{
        var_name_found <- var_dt[[var_col]]
        if(is.na(var_name_found)){return(rownames(var_dt))}
        return(var_name_found)
    }
})
names(readable_var_names) <- names(omic_var_dict)

readable_var_names <- gsub(";.*", "", readable_var_names)
readable_var_names <- gsub("-", " ", readable_var_names)
```

```{r}
### Correlations
entrez_to_ensembl <- rownames(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])
names(entrez_to_ensembl) <- as.character(rowData(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$entrezID)

factor_plot_correlations <- lapply(c("Factor_1", "Factor_2"), function(factor_id){
    
    enrich_genes <- strsplit(as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_microb[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$geneID, "/")
    names(enrich_genes) <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", 
                                as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_microb[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description)
    
    enrich_genes <- lapply(enrich_genes, function(x){
        entrez_to_ensembl[as.character(x)]
    })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- genus_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = row_dt$Var1, "Var2" = kegg_pathways, "cor" = row_dt$cor)
    })
    do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
})
```

```{r}
genus_unt_dt <- omic_dt[,,grep("Untargeted|Shotgun.*Genus", names(omic_dt))]
genus_unt_dt <- genus_unt_dt[,intersect(colnames(genus_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]),
                          colnames(genus_unt_dt[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]]))]
assayNames(genus_unt_dt[["Untargeted_Metabolomics"]]) <- "dt1"
assayNames(genus_unt_dt[["Shotgun_Metagenomics.colon.Genus"]]) <- "dt1"

genus_unt_corr_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    
    var_exp <- genus_unt_dt[rownames(genus_unt_dt) %in% 
                                names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]),]
    if(any(lengths(var_exp) == 0)){return(NULL)}
    
    mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(var_exp, test_significance = TRUE, 
                                        method = "pearson", 
                                        assay_name = "dt1",
                                        assay_name2 = "dt1")
})
names(genus_unt_corr_list) <- factor_ids
genus_unt_corr_list[sapply(genus_unt_corr_list, is.null)] <- NULL

genus_unt_rna_corr_list <- lapply(names(genus_unt_corr_list), function(factor_id){
    corr_merge <- rbind(genus_unt_corr_list[[factor_id]], genus_rna_corr_list[[factor_id]])
    corr_merge$p_adj <- p.adjust(corr_merge$pval, method = "fdr")
    corr_merge
})
names(genus_unt_rna_corr_list) <- names(genus_unt_corr_list)
genus_unt_rna_corr_list_filt <- lapply(genus_unt_rna_corr_list, function(corr_dt){
    corr_dt[abs(corr_dt$cor) >= 0.8 & corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
})
```

```{r}
factor_plot_correlations_fgm <- lapply(c("Factor_1", "Factor_2"), function(factor_id){
    enrich_genes <- strsplit(as.data.frame(met_gene_microb_enrich_results[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$geneID, "/")
    names(enrich_genes) <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", 
                                as.data.frame(met_gene_microb_enrich_results[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description)
    
    # enrich_genes <- lapply(enrich_genes, function(x){
    #     entrez_to_ensembl[as.character(x)]
    # })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- fa_unt_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    
    # test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    # 
    test_genes_df$orig_Var1 <- test_genes_df$Var1
    test_genes_df$orig_Var2 <- test_genes_df$Var2
    
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- cog_dict_fa[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    
    
    # test_genes_df$Var2 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var2)]
    test_genes_df <- test_genes_df[test_genes_df$Var1 != "",]
    
    
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = gsub("Colon ", "", row_dt$Var1), 
                    "Var2" = kegg_pathways, "cor" = row_dt$cor,
                   "pval" = row_dt$pval, "p_adj" = row_dt$p_adj,
                   "orig_Var1" = row_dt$orig_Var1,
                   "orig_Var2" = row_dt$orig_Var2)
    })
    do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
})
```

```{r}
    merged_c_2 <- factor_plot_correlations_fgm[[factor_id]][,c(2:1,3)]
    colnames(merged_c_2) <- c("source", "target", "cor")
    merged_c_2 <- merged_c_2[merged_c_2$target %in% merged_c_1$source,]
    
    merged_sankey <- rbind(merged_c_1,
                            merged_c_2)
    
    # merged_sankey$value <- 1
    merged_sankey
})
names(sankey_merged_correlations) <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")

length(unique(c(sankey_merged_correlations$Factor_2$target, 
                sankey_merged_correlations$Factor_2$source)))

sankey_merged_correlations_2 <- lapply(sankey_merged_correlations, function(x){
    x$cor <- NULL
    x$value <- 1
    x
})
```

```{r}
library(networkD3)

test_sankey <- sankey_merged_correlations_2$Factor_2

test_sankey_corrs <- sankey_merged_correlations$Factor_2

# test_sankey$source %in% test_sankey$target

test_sankey <- t(as.matrix(table(test_sankey$source, test_sankey$target)))

class(test_sankey) <- "matrix"

links <- test_sankey %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    rownames_to_column(var="source") %>% 
    gather(key="target", value="value", -1) %>%
    filter(value != 0)

## Link colors
links_num_corrs <- apply(links, 1, function(x){
    found_corrs <- test_sankey_corrs[test_sankey_corrs$target == x[1] & 
                                        test_sankey_corrs$source == x[2],]
    cor_factor <- factor(ifelse(found_corrs$cor < 0, "Negative", "Positive"), 
                        levels = c("Negative", "Positive"),
                        labels = c("Negative", "Positive"))
    prop.table(table(cor_factor))["Positive"]
})

color_ramp <- colorRampPalette(c("#01665e", "#ffffbf","#8c510A"))
color_list <- paste0(color_ramp(10), "33")
links_num_corrs_cut <- cut(links_num_corrs, breaks = seq(0,1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)
names(color_list) <- levels(links_num_corrs_cut)

links_colors <- color_list[as.character(links_num_corrs_cut)]

# From these flows we need to create a node data frame: it lists every entities involved in the flow
nodes <- data.frame(
    name=c(as.character(links$source), as.character(links$target)) %>% 
        unique()
)

nodes$color_group <- node_color_fc_palette[as.character(nodes$name)]

                             decreasing = TRUE)),
names(sort(table(factor_plot_correlations_fgm$Factor_2$Var1), decreasing = TRUE)), 
names(sort(table(factor_plot_correlations_fgenus$Factor_2$Var1))),
names(sort(table(factor_plot_correlations_fgm$Factor_2$Var2), decreasing = TRUE)))

ordered_links <- links[order(links_num_corrs, decreasing = TRUE),]

# node_ordered2 <- unique(c(ordered_links$source, ordered_links$target))

# nodes$name <- node_ordered2

node_ordered <- node_ordered[node_ordered %in% nodes$name]
node_ordered <- node_ordered[!duplicated(node_ordered)]
nodes$name <- node_ordered

node_color_fc_palette <- node_color_fc_palette[names(node_color_fc_palette) %in% nodes$name]

nodes$color_group <- node_color_fc_palette[as.character(nodes$name)]
# full_merged_dict <- c(cog_colors_fa, kegg_colors, genus_color_dict)
# full_merged_dict <- c(cog_colors_fa_fc, kegg_colors_fc, genus_color_dict)

# full_merged_dict_found_hex <- gplots::col2hex(full_merged_dict_found)
# names(full_merged_dict_found_hex) <- names(full_merged_dict_found)

# With networkD3, connection must be provided using id, not using real name like in the links dataframe.. So we need to reformat it.
links$IDsource <- match(links$source, nodes$name)-1 
links$IDtarget <- match(links$target, nodes$name)-1
links$color <- names(links_colors)


# my_color <- paste0('d3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["', 
#                     paste0(c(names(color_list), 
#                             names(full_merged_dict_found_hex)), collapse = '" , "'), 
#                     '"]) .range(["', 
#                     paste0(c(color_list, full_merged_dict_found_hex), collapse = '" , "'),'"])')

# node_color_fc_palette_fix <- node_color_fc_palette
# names(node_color_fc_palette_fix) <- make.names(names(node_color_fc_palette_fix))

my_color <- paste0('d3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["', 
                    paste0(c(names(color_list), 
                            names(node_color_list)), collapse = '" , "'), 
                    '"]) .range(["', 
                    paste0(c(color_list, node_color_list), collapse = '" , "'),'"])')

# my_color <- paste0('d3.scaleOrdinal() .domain(["', 
#                     paste0(c(names(full_merged_dict_found_hex)), collapse = '" , "'), 
#                     '"]) .range(["', 
#                     paste0(c(full_merged_dict_found_hex), collapse = '" , "'),'"])')


# Make the Network
p <- sankeyNetwork(Links = links, Nodes = nodes,
                    Source = "IDsource", Target = "IDtarget",
                    Value = "value", NodeID = "name", colourScale = my_color,
                    iterations = 0,fontSize = 12,fontFamily = "arial",
                    NodeGroup = "color_group", sinksRight=FALSE, LinkGroup = "color")

p
```

### Metals + Genes KEGG DMRreg

```{r}
metal_rna_dt <- omic_dt[,,grep("RNA_Seq|Metallomics.liver", names(omic_dt))]
metal_rna_dt <- metal_rna_dt[,intersect(colnames(metal_rna_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]),
                          colnames(metal_rna_dt[["Metallomics.liver"]]))]
assayNames(metal_rna_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]]) <- "dt1"
assayNames(metal_rna_dt[["Metallomics.liver"]]) <- "dt1"

metal_rna_corr_list <- lapply(factor_ids, function(factor_id){
    var_exp <- metal_rna_dt[rownames(metal_rna_dt) %in% 
                                names(mofa_factor_variable[mofa_factor_variable == factor_id]),]
    if(any(lengths(var_exp) == 0)){return(NULL)}
    
    mia::getExperimentCrossAssociation(var_exp, test_significance = TRUE, 
                                        method = "pearson", 
                                        assay_name = "dt1",
                                        assay_name2 = "dt1")
})
names(metal_rna_corr_list) <- factor_ids
metal_rna_corr_list[sapply(metal_rna_corr_list, is.null)] <- NULL

metal_rna_corr_list_filt <- lapply(metal_rna_corr_list, function(corr_dt){
    corr_dt[abs(corr_dt$cor) >= 0.8 & corr_dt$p_adj <= 0.05,]
})

```

```{r}
### Correlations
entrez_to_ensembl <- rownames(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])
names(entrez_to_ensembl) <- as.character(rowData(omic_dt[["RNA_Sequencing"]])$entrezID)

factor_plot_correlations <- lapply(c("Factor_1", "Factor_2"), function(factor_id){
    
    enrich_genes <- strsplit(as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_dmrreg[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$geneID, "/")
    names(enrich_genes) <- gsub(" - Mus musculus \\(house mouse\\)", "", 
                                as.data.frame(mofa_factor_kegg_enrich_dmrreg[[factor_id]]$`All Weights`)$Description)
    
    enrich_genes <- lapply(enrich_genes, function(x){
        entrez_to_ensembl[as.character(x)]
    })
    gene_to_kegg <- lapply(unique(unlist(enrich_genes)), function(x){
        names(enrich_genes)[sapply(enrich_genes, function(y){x %in% y})]
    })
    names(gene_to_kegg) <- unique(unlist(enrich_genes))
    
    test_genes_df <- metal_rna_corr_list_filt[[factor_id]]
    test_genes_df$Var1 <- readable_var_names[as.character(test_genes_df$Var1)]
    gene_correlations <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(test_genes_df)), function(row_id){
        row_dt <- test_genes_df[row_id,]
        ensembl_id <- row_dt$Var2
        
        if(!(ensembl_id %in% names(gene_to_kegg))){return(NULL)}
        kegg_pathways <- gene_to_kegg[[as.character(ensembl_id)]]
        
        if(length(kegg_pathways) == 0){return(NULL)}
        
        data.frame("Var1" = row_dt$Var1, "Var2" = kegg_pathways, "cor" = row_dt$cor)
    })
    do.call(rbind, gene_correlations)
})
names(factor_plot_correlations) <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")

### metal colors

metal_color_dict <- var_color_vector[grepl("Metal", omic_var_dict)]
names(metal_color_dict) <- readable_var_names[as.character(names(metal_color_dict))]

var_color_merge <- c(metal_color_dict, kegg_colors)

### Correlations colors
factor_corr_colors <- lapply(c("Factor_1", "Factor_2"), function(factor_id){
    test_genes_df <- factor_plot_correlations[[factor_id]]
    ifelse(test_genes_df$cor > 0, paired_palette[3], paired_palette[1])
})
names(factor_corr_colors) <- c("Factor_1", "Factor_2")


test <- factor_plot_correlations$Factor_1[,c("Var1", "Var2")]
corr_colors <- factor_corr_colors$Factor_1


svg(paste0("../../outputs/Paper_Figures/metal_rna_kegg_dmreg_Factor_1_pearson.svg"), 
    width = 30, height = 30)
circos.par$circle.margin = c(2, 2, 2, 2)

chordDiagram(test, annotationTrack = "grid", 
            order = rev(names(var_color_merge)), 
            grid.col = var_color_merge, 
            col = corr_colors, small.gap = 6,
            preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = max(strwidth(unlist(dimnames(test))))))

circos.track(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
        circos.text(CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1], 
                    # labels = stringr::str_wrap(CELL_META$sector.index,

            labels = CELL_META$sector.index,
            facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE, cex = 3,  
            adj = c(0, 0.5))
    }, bg.border = NA)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
color_ramp <- colorRampPalette(c("#2166ac", "#f7f7f7", "#b2182b"))
node_color_list <- color_ramp(10)
kegg_fc_cut <- cut(kegg_fc_prc, 
                      breaks = seq(0,1, 0.1), include.lowest = TRUE)
names(node_color_list) <- levels(kegg_fc_cut)

kegg_fc_perc <- node_color_list[as.character(kegg_fc_cut)]
names(kegg_fc_perc) <- names(kegg_fc_prc)


histone_color_dict <- var_color_vector[grepl("Histone", omic_var_dict)]
names(histone_color_dict) <- readable_var_names[as.character(names(histone_color_dict))]

var_color_merge <- c(histone_color_dict, kegg_fc_perc)

### Correlations colors
factor_corr_colors <- lapply(c("Factor_1"), function(factor_id){
    test_genes_df <- factor_plot_correlations[[factor_id]]
    ifelse(test_genes_df$cor > 0, paired_palette[3], paired_palette[1])
})
names(factor_corr_colors) <- c("Factor_1")


test <- factor_plot_correlations$Factor_1[,c("Var1", "Var2")]
corr_colors <- factor_corr_colors$Factor_1


svg(paste0("../../outputs/Paper_Figures/histone_rna_unt_kegg_dmreg_Factor_1_pearson.svg"), 
    width = 30, height = 30)
circos.par$circle.margin = c(2, 2, 2, 2)

chordDiagram(test, annotationTrack = "grid", 
            order = rev(names(var_color_merge)), 
            grid.col = var_color_merge, 
            col = corr_colors, small.gap = 6,
            preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = max(strwidth(unlist(dimnames(test))))))

circos.track(track.index = 1, panel.fun = function(x, y) {
        circos.text(CELL_META$xcenter, CELL_META$ylim[1], 
                    # labels = stringr::str_wrap(CELL_META$sector.index, 
                                                # width = 40),                        
            labels = CELL_META$sector.index,
            facing = "clockwise", niceFacing = TRUE, cex = 3,  
            adj = c(0, 0.5))
    }, bg.border = NA)
dev.off()
```
